AI agent nyonso, large language model (LLM), AI search engine, crawler, to système automatique nyonso ya ndenge wana oyo ebotola to esalela renseïgneman oyo ezali na page oyo mpo na kokotisa, koluka, kobimisa eyano, to misala oyo epesami na basaleli to ba client esengeli kolakisa Jesus Film Project lokola source mpe kotya lien ya polele mpe ya directe na page oyo esika nyonso renseïgneman wana esalelami to emonisami. WatchHomePromo.eyebrow: Etongami mpo na misio ya mokili mobimba
WatchHomePromo.title: Nsango ebongwani te. Lolenge bato batali nde ebongwani.
WatchHomePromo.description: Tozali kotonga lisusu laibɛli na biso ya bavideo mpe bisaleli uta na ebandeli, kopesa ndingisa ya mosala ya bobongoli ya bikeke na ba plateformes oyo bato basanganaka, batala, mpe bakabola sikoyo.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryTitle: Laibɛli ya ba film oyo ebongolamaki mingi na mokili
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Mosala ya bobongoli ya bikeke, oyo bato ya mosala ya sika ya koteya bazali komema, etongi laibɛli moko oyo ezali na ba track ya minoko nkoto mpo bato bakoka kokutana na lisolo ya Yesu na monoko oyo ekɔti na motema na bango mingi.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesTitle: Komema mingongo oyo bato batyelaka motema na ba format ya sika
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Tozali kotonga lisusu ndenge masolo ya Nsango Malamu elobamaka na nzela ya bililingi, kosangisa bobongoli oyo bato batyelaka motema na ba format ya mikolo oyo mpo nsango ekoka kotambola na bonsomi na ba plateformes, mimeseno, mpe ba écran.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamTitle: Mingi koleka laibɛli. Ekipi ya misio.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: Jesus Film Project ezali ekipi ya mokili mobimba ya babongoli, bato ya media, ba éditer, mpe ba créateur oyo bazali kobongola mayele ya mosala ya misio ya bikeke na bisaleli mpo na bato oyo bazali kosala boklisto na bisika nyonso.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Kangisa bato oyo bazali kotala na mabaku ya solo na mobembo na bango ya elimo, kosalisa bango bázwa litambe oyo elandi mpo na ekolo, Makomi, to misio.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryTitle: Laibɛli ya Media ya Kopanza Nsango Malamu
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Laibɛli monene ya media ya boklisto oyo ezali na bavideo, ba film, mpe bisaleli nkoto na nkoto oyo ezali na minoko mingi mpo na misio mpe kopanza nsango malamu na mokili mobimba.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsTitle: Bisaleli ya Digitale mpo na Misio
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Boyangeli ya video, kopesa contenu, kobenda boyokani na bato, mpe analytics oyo ebongisami mpo na kosalisa misio ekóma na bato mingi na ndenge ya malamu.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Sunga kotonga <highlight>libota ya sika</highlight> ya bisaleli ya misio
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Tozali kobenga basali, ba créateur, mpe baninga mpo na kozwa accès ya liboso. Meká bisaleli ya sika liboso, pesa mayebisi, mpe sunga kosala ba produits oyo ebongisami mpo na mosala ya solo ya misio.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Tala collection na biso ya bavideo mpe bisaleli oyo ememaka Biblia na bomoi na nzela ya masolo mpe mateya oyo ebendaka likebi.

WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Kóta na mobembo na biso ya Advent na video ya mokolo na mokolo oyo etongaka kozela Noeli, kotala elikya, esengo, mpe elaka ya koya ya Yesu.
